name: Lakes Of Mongolia
summary:
Journey across Mongolia and experience 23 of its remarkable lakes in immersive virtual reality.

23 Lakes of Mongolia VR brings you closer to some of the country’s most beautiful and remote natural landscapes—from vast open steppe and dramatic mountains to crystal-clear waters and peaceful shorelines.
